component.name: Mithrandir-RS
component.summary: Blazing-fast Linux system cleaner, real-time hardware telemetry, hardware power saver, and system tray integration in Rust

description.p: Mithrandir-RS is a high-performance system maintenance suite, cleaner, and diagnostic toolkit rewritten entirely in Rust with GTK4 and Libadwaita. It delivers instantaneous cleanup scans, deep cache pruning, hardware power management, and granular control over startup services and system processes without background resource overhead.

Designed with a focus on safety and transparency, Mithrandir-RS protects critical operating system paths, features a quarantined ClamAV vault, and runs diagnostic telemetry off the main UI thread for completely stutter-free operation.

ul.li: High-Throughput Cleaner: Multi-threaded cleanup for package caches, thumbnails, application logs, and Flatpak runtimes
Hardware Power Saver: One-click CPU Turbo disabling, EPP power profiles, and PCIe ASPM deep power saving
Pure Rust System Tray: StatusNotifierItem and DBusMenu panel integration adapting automatically to Light/Dark desktop themes
Zero-Sleep Real-Time Telemetry: Instant CPU delta calculation, dual GPU metrics, and battery health reporting
Debounced Smart Boost: Safe one-click memory optimization and temporary file reclamation
Quarantine Vault: Integrated ClamAV scanning with secure isolation for flagged files
Integrated Mini-LLM Manager: One-click download and execution of local GGUF models via llama.cpp or Ollama
Dual AI Diagnostics: Real-time diagnostic assistance powered by local offline models or Google Gemini and Claude APIs

description.p: Mithrandir-RS v0.4.4 introduces major codebase optimizations, reliability fixes, and persistent user preferences:

ul.li: Consolidated Linux distribution detection natively into os_info, avoiding redundant filesystem reads.
Eliminated overlapping directory walks in Cleaner to prevent duplicate cache size counting.
Optimized process list sorting with zero heap allocations during telemetry cycles.
Cached CPU thermal sysfs paths to eliminate 48 redundant syscalls per second.
Prevented subprocess pipe deadlocks in HostBridge streaming execution.
Connected Preferences dialog controls to persistent configuration storage.
Replaced UI polling loops with reactive glib event-driven channels.

description.p: Mithrandir-RS v0.4.2 introduces native System Tray integration, Hardware Power Saver mode, and multi-distribution adaptability:

ul.li: Pure Rust StatusNotifierItem (SNI) and DBusMenu system tray panel icon without GTK3 runtime collisions.
Hardware Power Saver controller managing Intel P-State CPU Turbo Boost, CPU EPP policies, and PCIe ASPM powersupersave.
Bidirectional power saver state synchronization between the Libadwaita UI and desktop panel indicator.
Dynamic udev permissions generator enabling passwordless power management on wheel and sudo distros.
Cross-distribution auto-adaptation for Fedora, Debian, Ubuntu, Arch Linux, openSUSE, and NixOS.
Support for --background and --minimized autostart flags.

description.p: Release v0.4.1 with native Google Gemini AI Studio and Anthropic Claude support.
Initial stable Rust release with GTK4/Libadwaita UI, async telemetry, and local AI manager.
